name: Team Communications Planning
description: Reliable out-of-band communications between team members is a critical operational requirement for any multi-operator physical engagement. Cell phones are vulnerable to network outages and RF shielding inside large buildings. Two-way radios provide direct, infrastructure-independent comms that function in basements, parking garages, and RF-shielded spaces. Establish brevity codes, challenge/response signals, and abort signals before every operation — not during.

blue.det: Difficult to detect directly; encrypted comms leave no exploitable signal; unusual radio frequency activity near facility may be detectable.
blue.cm: RF monitoring near sensitive facilities; detect unusual encrypted radio traffic; TSCM awareness for high-security sites.
